crossRefs.note: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.
He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families; and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son…
Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.
To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe…
These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech…
The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in…

translations.web: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
translations.bsb: Casting the lot ends quarrels and separates strong opponents.
translations.kjv: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
translations.asv: The lot causeth contentions to cease, And parteth between the mighty.
